title: Anvesa Project Configuration Schema (v1)
description: Configuration file for Anvesa code intelligence and search engine (.anvesa/config.json). Defines embedding model, channels, fusion rank parameters, indexing, syntax chunking, search tuning, and security constraints.

$schema.description: URI to the Anvesa config JSON Schema for editor autocomplete and validation.

model.description: A built-in model id (e.g. 'sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2'). Unset means the tier the machine suits.

channels.description: Channel configurations keyed by channel name (e.g., 'notes', 'docs').

enabled.description: Whether this channel is indexed and searched.

weight.description: Weight multiplier for this channel in reciprocal rank fusion.

module.description: Path to a custom channel transformer module relative to the project root.

sha256.description: SHA-256 integrity hash for pinned custom channel modules.

k.description: Reciprocal rank fusion constant k (higher values smooth differences across ranks).

fragments.description: Partition index into multiple fragment databases as defined in .anvesa/fragments.json.

ignore.description: Additional glob patterns to ignore during repository indexing beyond .gitignore.

maxFileSizeBytes.description: Skip indexing files larger than this size in bytes (default 512KB).

concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent worker operations during indexing.

embeddingBatchSize.description: Number of text chunks to embed per batch pass.

requireChecksums.description: Refuse to load any custom channel module that is not pinned with a sha256 checksum.

search.description: Default parameters and thresholds for query and search operations.

defaultLimit.description: Default maximum number of search results to return when not specified.

excludeLanes.description: Retrieval lanes to exclude by default (e.g. ['docs', 'structural']).

minScore.description: Minimum cosine similarity cutoff for dense matches.

collapse.description: Collapse multiple search result chunks originating from the same symbol or card group.

syntax.description: AST parsing and code chunking configuration.

stripComments.description: Strip comments from AST code cards to conserve token and vector space.

maxChunkLines.description: Maximum number of source lines per extracted AST code chunk.

minChunkLines.description: Minimum number of source lines required for a distinct code chunk.

redteam.description: Adversarial detection and card quarantine security settings.

maxCardsPerSource.description: Anti-flood card generation threshold per source file.

quarantineOnSuspect.description: Quarantine any card suspected of containing prompt injections or adversarial payload.
